status: Final packet 27 (CR15/c) gate; registered before any measured run (a wiring smoke of 4 runs preceded it).

slo.source: User decision 2026-11-07, recorded in the feature doc before this gate

change: Process-wide admission (12 unique source searches, joiners free, the 13th fast SearchOverloadedError -> 503); 15 s overall deadline from owned-task start with partial results; per-indexer download gate (5) admitting only while the process-wide pending-byte budget (32 MiB) has room; one store at a time in chunks of at most 16 MiB; TorrentInfo cache also bounded by 50 000 file entries.
previous: cr15c-after-v1 PASS on the CR15a v2 base, -v2 PASS on the CR15a v3 tree, -v3 PASS on the CR15a v5 tree; rerun because the landing runtime changed (CR15a v6: Dockerfile glibc ENV, ff1a39a; server/app identical to v3). (The v3 protocol text names itself where -v2 was meant.)
workload: Unchanged burst27 fixture/harness (as burst27-v3): N simultaneous unique IMDb searches, 40 candidates each, typical ~5.7 MB and heavy ~111 MB per search.
sampling: Two series x five before/after pairs; within a pair index all cells run, each as an ABBA-ordered before/after pair; fresh client and server per run.
resources: client 2 CPU on 0,1 / 1 GiB, no swap, DB on a fresh anonymous volume; server 1 CPU on 6 / 512 MiB; runs alongside the CR15a v6 (8-10), 26b normal v6 (2-4) and 26a/26b functional (12-14) gates on disjoint cpusets.
decision: PASS iff all of: (A) every after run exits 0 without OOM, guard timeout or outbound call, and every before typical run N<=12 completes; (B) after typical N in {1,4,8,12}: every search returns 40 sources, 0 errors, 40 unique hashes; after typical N=16: exactly 12 searches complete correctly and exactly 4 raise SearchOverloadedError within 100 ms each; after heavy N in {1,4,12}: every search returns either 40 correct sources or a partial result with exactly one error (the deadline message), no exception, and no search exceeds 18 000 ms (15 s deadline + bounded store of already downloaded bytes); (C) after typical N<=12: both series medians of run p95 <= 15 000 ms; (D) no repeatable degradation for typical N in {1,4,8,12} in p50_ms, p95_ms, anon_peak_delta, cpu_seconds: degradation iff both after series medians > before max (all ten) + J, J = max(|median before s1 - median before s2|, resolution 1 ms / 1 ms / 1 MiB / 0.01 s). Before heavy and N=16 cells are descriptive. FAIL otherwise; INVALID if runs are missing or a before typical N<=12 run fails.
pre_registration_diagnostics: Candidate tuning on the burst harness (not gate data): heavy N=4 anon peak +745 MiB at 64/32 MiB budget, +497 MiB at 32/16 MiB; typical N=12 p95 9.7 s; heavy N=12 no OOM, searches end by ~15.2 s.
